settings.title: Pet size & weight
settings.content:
Fits cats and small dogs up to about 6 kg (13 lb) that sit comfortably in the pouch, supported by your arms.

Bigger or very wriggly pets may prefer a lap cuddle instead.

settings.title: Safe cuddles
settings.content:
• Always support your pet from below with your arms. The pouch is for cuddles, not hands-free carrying.
  • Don't use it while driving, cycling, cooking or doing anything where your pet could get hurt.
  • Start with a few minutes at home and let your pet climb out whenever they want. Never leave them in the pouch unattended or in the heat.

settings.title: Care
settings.content: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Air-dry flat. Don't tumble dry, bleach or iron.

settings.title: Shipping & Christmas delivery
settings.content: Free worldwide shipping with tracking. US orders usually arrive in 9–17 days; Canada, the UK and Australia in 10–20 days; most other countries in 12–25 days. All taxes and import duties are included, so there's nothing extra to pay on delivery. Full shipping policy

settings.title: Our guarantee
settings.content: If it arrives damaged or faulty, send a photo to support@suzeno.com within 30 days and we'll refund you or send a replacement. Wrong size? Email us and we'll help.

settings.heading: Warm hugs, all winter
settings.text:
Movie nights, slow mornings and holiday photos. Plush fleece outside, a zip-up pouch up front, and your little one snuggled right where they love to be: with you.

It's a cozy hoodie on its own too, with a kangaroo hand pocket and drawstring hood.

settings.heading: Size guide
settings.intro: Relaxed, roomy fit to make room for your pet. Garment measurements may vary by 1–3 cm.
settings.tip: Between sizes or carrying a bigger pet? Size up. Tip: lay a hoodie you love flat, measure across the chest and double it.

settings.question: How does the pet pouch work?
settings.answer: Unzip the curved zip at the top of the front pouch and let your pet climb in. Their head pops out through the round, soft-edged opening, then zip it back so they stay snug against you. Always support them from below with your arms.

settings.question: Which pets is it for?
settings.answer: Cats and small dogs up to about 6 kg (13 lb) that sit comfortably in the pouch. Start with short cuddle sessions at home and let them climb out whenever they want.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: Pick your usual size: the fit is relaxed to make room for your pet. Between sizes? Size up.

settings.question: Will it arrive before Christmas?
settings.answer: Order by December 5 for the US, December 2 for Canada, the UK and Australia, and November 28 for other countries.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Turn it inside out and machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Air-dry flat; don't tumble dry or iron.

settings.question: Will I pay customs fees or taxes?
settings.answer: No. Our prices include all taxes and import duties, so the price at checkout is the final price. If a carrier ever asks you for a fee, contact us before paying and we'll take care of it.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit or arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact support@suzeno.com within 30 days of delivery. If it arrives damaged or faulty, we'll refund you or send a replacement. For a different size, email us and we'll help.
